channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Rescued By Robots: Ukrainian Unit Uses Ground Drones To Save Soldiers On The Battlefield
item.description: Aerial drones are among the deadliest weapons in Ukraine's fight against Russian forces, but unmanned vehicles also play a crucial role on the ground. Near the front lines in the Donetsk region, one unit deploys ground drones to deliver supplies and evacuate wounded soldiers from the battlefield.

item.title: UK Defense Secretary: Our Job Is To Step Up Further For Ukraine
item.description: Speaking with RFE/RL at the Munich Security Conference, UK Defense Secretary John Healey called for further aid for Ukraine and increased pressure on Russian President Vladimir Putin. He also said he witnessed Ukraine's defiance and courage on a recent trip to the country.

item.title: Zelenskyy Calls For Strong Security Guarantees Against 'Slave To War' Putin
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy delivered an impassioned plea for more Western weapons and for "real security guarantees," calling Russian President Vladimir Putin a "slave to war" who will threaten Europe if he is not stopped in Ukraine.

item.title: Russia Poisoned Navalny With Exotic Frog Toxin, European Countries Say
item.description: The governments of five European countries on February 14 released a statement saying that they are confident that the Russian opposition politician Aleksei Navalny was poisoned with a lethal toxin not found naturally in Russia -- a poisoning that led to his death in a Russian prison two years ago.

item.title: Iranian Opposition Holds Largest Ever Protest In Europe, With 250,000 People In Munich
item.description: Some 250,000 people have joined a demonstration in the Bavarian capital, German police told RFE/RL, in the largest ever protest in Europe by opponents of the authorities in Iran.

item.title: Zelenskyy: Peace Can Only Be Built On Clear Security Guarantees
item.description: Speaking at the Munich Security Conference on February 14, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy delivered an impassioned plea for more Western weapons and for "real security guarantees," calling Russian President Vladimir Putin a "slave to war" who will threaten Europe if he is not stopped.

item.title: Mass Crowds Protest Against Iran’s Regime On Sidelines Of Munich Conference
item.description: Huge numbers of protesters turned out in Munich to protest against the government of Iran as world leaders gathered in the city for the annual security conference. German police estimated that some 250,000 people joined the demonstration.

item.title: Zelenskyy Says European Security Guarantees Crucial To Ukraine
item.description: Speaking with RFE/RL at the Munich Security Conference, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said one of Ukraine's main tasks is to ensure the country is not left alone at the negotiating table with Russia. He emphasized the importance of both American and European support to Ukrainian security.

item.title: Hundreds Of Thousands In Munich Protest Against Iranian Regime
item.description: Iranians living in exile gathered in Munich to protest against the government of Iran as world leaders gathered in the city for the annual security conference. Protesters said they were there to show their unity in condemning Tehran in the wake of a brutal crackdown on nationwide protests in Iran.

item.title: Rubio Reassures Zelenskyy Of US Commitment, But Warns Of 'Hard' Concessions
item.description: On his second day at the Munich Security Conference, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio set out to calm nerves and sharpen focus: Ukraine and security, he signaled, very much remain the center of gravity of Washington’s transatlantic policy.
